items_missed: Never asked for or used the customer's name — the customer had to ask for the REP's name at the end ('Can I know your name again, please?')
No 'How are you today?' and no agenda statement or 'Sound good?' confirmation
Never captured contact info — no email, no phone, no address. Nothing was recorded to follow up on a live 4,000 sqft lead
Never offered to send a confirmation or estimate email
No probing on stairs/floors, garage or storage rooms, long walks or narrow hallways, elevator/parking/HOA access, additional stops, or packing needs
Never asked the moving-stressors question ('anything you're particularly worried about?')
Entire Clock section skipped — no 'clock starts on-site', no 2.5-hour minimum, no 15-minute prorated increments, no sense-check
Entire Save Your Ass prep speech skipped
No No Worries Damage Coverage explanation — said 'insurance' in the included list but never the $2,000 coverage
No Meet Your Mover, no On-Time Guarantee
Said 'no hidden fees of any kind' but never itemized (no credit card fees, no transportation fees, no fuel surcharge, no assembly fees)
No typical time range and no actual estimate for a 4,000 sqft home — only quoted 2 movers at $204/hr with no hours attached

Price objection mishandled: customer said 'I'm getting some quotes for slightly lower' and complimented the company as professional; rep answered only 'Yes, that's the only rate we offer' with no value reframe
No booking attempt — customer signaled buying intent and flexible dates 8/24-8/30 and the rep never asked to lock a date
top_strength: Handled the specialty-item screen cleanly and honestly — proactively flagged that Einstein does not move pool tables, then clarified upright vs. grand on the piano before confirming Einstein could take it. The included-items list (gas, truck, taxes, insurance, blankets, stretch wrap, dollies, tool bag) was delivered accurately and quickly.
coaching_note: Get the name and contact info on every call — this was a ready-to-book 4,000 sqft lead with an open date range and the rep let it hang up with nothing captured and no email offered. Second priority: when a customer names a lower competitor quote AND compliments your professionalism, that is an invitation to sell value (No Worries Damage Coverage, On-Time Guarantee, Meet Your Mover), not a moment to say 'that's the only rate we offer.'
phone_presence_notes: Courteous but clipped and mechanical — mostly one-line answers, no affirmations or empathy markers, and the customer's compliment and price concern both went unacknowledged, though the farewell was warm.
audio_review_reason: Presence scored 2 — verify whether the clipped transcript reflects genuinely flat delivery or just an efficient, sparse inbound call.
